title: proofs outside codemother run build_inspector's sieves over the bus
intention: Every proof outside CodeMother that runs one of build_inspector's sieves over itself or a fixture asks her `inspect` verb over its own scratch bus instead of importing the inspector.
why: Child of 4c4addb09adb (CairnCommons/tickets/4c4addb09adb-the-code-pipeline-s-inspectors-and-gates-live-inside-codemother.json). Akien 2026-10-27, open-0b203e62c1e0: 'everything that has no purpose other than helping our design and build pipeline for code belongs to code mother.' Outline 9.4.3.3.4, Akien 2026-11-13 on Q#88: once build_inspector moves into CodeMother, code outside her reaches it over the bus — the 18 crossing calls in transitions.py, the other code sites and the proofs that run a sieve over themselves; no published client tool, no fifth exception: 'over the bus. that's what it's for?'
traces_to: outline 9.4.3.3.4 and 10.3.5; RULE 1 (encapsulation, 17.13.1); Law 6 (one owner gates writes)
how: D1: ORDER. Builds after the verb child (266d39d56d06). The proofs of corrosion, exemptions and rehearsal are in this set: measured 2026-11-13 they import build_inspector while it imports them, so until these ask over the bus, whichever moves first leaves an outside machine reaching into codemother (RULE 1). EXTENDED 2026-11-13 (orchestrator, after this ticket's census): also builds after 7ea59855b1f4, which publishes inspect_wire.ask(), grows INSPECT_JUDGES by the 13 off-list names and publishes fixture(berths=, tickets_root=, crossing_roots=) for the 7 proofs that wrote inspector globals; every proof here imports only cairn.devices.codemother.tools.inspect_wire and asks through ask(). D2: each listed proof gets its scratch bus from cairn/devices/cairn/tools/scratch_bus and asks `inspect`; its PROVES keys and tickets are unchanged, and each reseals with bin/cairn test --seal --ruling <this id>. D3: PROOF: an AST census over every proof outside codemother.

clauses.claim: no proof outside cairn/devices/codemother/ imports cairn.machines.build_inspector or its codemother address (AST read over every tracked proofs/*.py)
every proof in the list reseals green under its standing PROVES keys
